items.title: Chester Jones Interview, 1961-07-10
items.q: All I knew him was about Faisal. ... I think he was a loud type of drummer... I come more closest to Faisal.

ctx.x: Well, would they come down on the banquet or would they be on the porch or what?

Yeah, before they go in, well, Copperhead Hall didn't have a porch. They used to play right in front of the hall. Yeah, the band would play two or three numbers before they go inside. And, well, we all, all the kids and everybody would gang around and listen at them. Well, it was always my ambition to play drum. I love the drums. I'd look at the guys. Well, when I'd get ready to go upstairs to play, I'd grab probably the snare drum or something. I want to bring his drum upstairs for him. And after I get up there,…
He's rough. Yeah, he's pretty rough. And what would he play him? Was he a guy on the snare all the time or would he play all over the set?
